version: 0.4.0
kind: project-manifest
schema_type: manifest

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.project-manifest
  name: project-manifest.schema
  description: Canonical schema for Prismata project manifests.

spec:
  target_kind: project-manifest
  naming:
    file_suffix: .project.manifest.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: name
    path: name
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: version
    path: version
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: description
    path: description
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: capabilities
    path: capabilities
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  - name: dependencies
    path: dependencies
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

object:
  udi: ""
  id: ""
  name: ""
  version: ""
  description: ""
  capabilities: []
  dependencies: []
